name: io.github.nirholas/blender-mcp
title: three.ws Blender
description: Drive a local Blender headlessly: inspect, convert, render and script 3D files.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Blender 3.0+ executable. Leave unset to discover it on PATH and at the platform's standard install locations.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for one Blender job in milliseconds. Renders and heavy conversions are the slow ones.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for outputs written when a tool is called without an explicit output path.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_ALLOW_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to withdraw blender_run_python, which executes caller-supplied Python inside Blender, from the advertised tool list.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_INLINE_IMAGE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on inlined image bytes. Past this the image stays on disk and the response says where.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_INLINE_IMAGE_PX
environmentVariables.description: Longest edge of the render copy returned inline in a tool result. The full-resolution PNG is always written to disk.

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: How many Blender processes may run at once. Further calls queue rather than compete for memory.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the three.ws deployment backing blender_forge_import.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_FORGE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for one text-to-3D generation in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: THREE_WS_FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Meshy/Tripo API key for the bring-your-own-key geometry lane. The default image lane is free and needs no key.
